## P05.3 — completion notes

Run `a4c9080ac4145d3cff9b7a0fa158ca014393d0324195e1769ac215def8382725` (solo, route `claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5/high`, class `implementation/high`; the route is the owner invocation of `task:plan-run … P05.3`). Review by an independent model, see below.

## Delivered

- **Gate `runtime-globals`** (`scripts/runtime-globals-gate.php`, `scripts/runtime-globals.json`, `scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json`, composer script `runtime-globals-gate`). Token based G1–G5; comments and strings never count; `use` statements are resolved (plain, grouped `use A\{B}`, `use function … as`, class aliases). Exit 0 OK, 1 violation, 2 configuration error (a baseline path outside `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/` exits 2). Negative controls in `tests/Arch/RuntimeGlobalsTest.php`: G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, "baseline exceeded", "baseline outside prefix", plus the grouped-use, aliased-helper and aliased-Carbon bypasses.
- **`SingletonInjectionGate` L2/L3** (`tests/Support/SingletonInjectionGate.php`): L2 singleton constructor takes a type registered `scoped`; L3 singleton constructor takes `Illuminate\Database\Connection|ConnectionInterface`; union and intersection constructor types are inspected; a singleton factory that only forwards `$app->make(X::class)` is analysed as X. `scripts/singleton-injection-allowlist.json` has `entries: []` (`PubSubManager` and the `ServiceProviderModuleRegistrar` `Application` capture are gone). Negative controls in `tests/Arch/SingletonInjectionTest.php` (L2, L3, union, forwarding factory, empty allowlist).
- **Conversion** of the runtime code of `core`, `access`, `custom-fields`, `intl`, `media`, `notifications`, `operations`, `panels`, `search`, `tasks`, `tasks-workflow`, `transfer`, `wakeup`, `webhooks`, `workflow` and `tenancy` (outside `Impersonation/**`) to constructor dependencies: `ConnectionResolverInterface` with `connection()` called at operation time, `Psr\Clock\ClockInterface`, `Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher`, `Auth\Factory`, `Cache\Factory`, `Http\Client\Factory` (`createPendingRequest()`), `Debug\ExceptionHandler`, `Psr\Log\LoggerInterface`. Host-visible bridges stay in `Laravel/` (`ApplicationLocator`, `CurrentActorResolver`, `DomainEventDefaults`, `ResolvesCoreOptions`).
- `PubSubManager` removed; `PubSub` binds through a `match` on `CoreOptions::pubsubDriver`. `ServiceProviderModuleRegistrar` and `DefaultWorkerRuntime` take `Closure(): Application` (`ApplicationLocator::current(...)`). `SystemRoleMutationScope` (scoped) replaces the static flag of `SystemRoleImmutable`.
- Wakeup `SystemClock` removed in favour of `CoreX\Time\Laravel\SystemClock`.

## Deviations and findings worth keeping

- **Test-induced lifetime seams.** Tests that rebind a service after a scoped/singleton consumer was resolved must reset the consumer (`Event::fake()` before building the coordinator, `forgetInstance(CurrentActor)`, `TestCase::trustTemplate()` forgets the template-integrity singletons). These are test harness changes, not product behavior.
- **Time strings.** Comparing a database string with a `DateTimeImmutable` never orders (the object is always greater). Review round 1 found three such claims (notifications delivery, two in media) that would accept a future retry; fixed with `notYetDue()` and covered by a regression test in `NotificationCenterTest`.
- `Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Repository` has no `lock()`: `ApplyMembershipProjection` obtains the lock through `getStore()` + `LockProvider` and throws when the store has none.
- `TenancyPortBindings` still builds `ApplyMembershipProjection` through the container although its constructor takes a string; this predates P05.3 and was left alone.
- Disk was full during the run: `bc-check` was run with `TMPDIR=/dev/shm`.

## Independent review

review: codex/gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh findings:5 (round 1, read-only, fresh context, model differs from the executor) → all fixed; recheck findings:3 (round 2) → all fixed, **not re-verified by the reviewer** (the two-round limit of D71 is spent). Raw outputs: `validation/review-round1-codex-gpt-6.1-sol.md`, `validation/review-round2-codex-gpt-6.1-sol.md`. A first launch that died with its shell and a duplicate run produced a third, partial report (4 findings, all fixed too).

| Finding | Fix |
|:--|:--|
| Round 1: digest wakeup adapter retained the registering application | resolves `DigestWakeupHandler` through `Container::getInstance()` at call time |
| Round 1: `DomainEvent` with an explicit tenant needed a bound clock | `DomainEventDefaults::now()` falls back to `SystemClock` |
| Round 1: gate G1–G3 ignored grouped `use`, `use function … as`, aliased Carbon | `collectImports()` resolves them; negative controls |
| Round 1: L2/L3 skipped union/intersection types; forwarding factories | `namedMembers()` flattens unions, intersections and DNF; `$app->make(X::class)` and declared factory return types are analysed |
| Extra (partial report): `modify('+N seconds')` crosses a DST rollback as 3660 s | seconds and minutes use `add(new DateInterval('PT…'))` (days stay calendar days) |
| Extra: G4 missed intersection-typed static properties; typed helper factories bypassed L3 | tokens `T_AMPERSAND_*` accepted; return type of the factory closure analysed |
| Round 2: bulk result/failure readers kept the first application | registered `scoped` |
| Round 2: stored time strings parsed in the PHP default zone | parsed in the zone of the clock (`$now->getTimezone()`) |
| Round 2: namespace aliases and case-insensitive aliases escaped G1/G3 | `resolveClassName()`; negative controls |

Unresolved after round 2 (named for the owner): none known; the three round-2 fixes have no reviewer confirmation.
